verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms FireHydrant serves an llms.txt at docs.firehydrant.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product-level summary an agent can be pointed at. Doc pages are also available as raw Markdown (.md URLs), which is agent-friendly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/agent docs, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g., an llms-full.txt or full page coverage).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.firehydrant.com/llms.txt # FireHydrant Documentation Documentation
FireHydrant enables you to create webhooks that respond to internal events or custom commands to send information to external systems.
